about: Interface font size (tasks 20261005-interface-font-size and -conversion): which Contract lengths are rem (follow the root font size the Interface font size sets) and which stay px, as T3 Code 1e2ecbd975 sizes them. Under `rem`, each property lists the px values at the default 16 that became N/16 rem (at Interface font size 12 they are ×0.75, at 20 ×1.25; "ternary": a bound choice of literals, each converted). The live drive in the task record checks them with `layout` at 12, 16 and 20.

rule.rem: Tailwind spacing, size, text, leading, tracking and radius utilities in the reference: font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, width/height and min/max, gap, padding, margin, top/right/bottom/left/inset, border-radius, flex-basis; icon sizes (`width=size`, size-N utilities) as `${size / 16}rem`
rule.px: borders (border-width, ring), shadows, blur, stroke and svg geometry, popover offsets (sideOffset), hairlines and dots of 1-2 px (h-px, w-px, size-[3px], h-[2px]), the 52 px top bar (--workspace-topbar-height), table minimum widths (min-w-[760px] and the like), prompt/code/diff/terminal text (their own px settings: monospace text keeps the Code font size)
rule.jsLayout: Values computed in TypeScript stay px unless listed under jsLayoutConverted; a bound expression that adds px from the layout (e.g. controlsLeft) to a rem length takes the root size as a number (Contract calc() takes percent ± px only)

jsLayoutConverted.what: look.fontSize = clampInterfaceFontSize(fontSizeInterface): the root font size app.contract `rootFont` sets
chat width setting: 46rem / 72rem (--chat-content-max-width) at the root size
chatLaneMetrics: ps-5 and min-w-[40rem] at the root size
sidebar minimum width from the brand probe (already per size)
composer menu widths and heights and the send tooltip width (atRootFontSize)
top-bar start inset: 1.25rem, or the traffic lights + 2.5rem with the sidebar closed
the gap under each timeline row (rowGap) as rem

pendingArea.files: every `px` entry below whose why is "bound expression": sizes computed in TypeScript (menus outside the composer, tooltips from text-width estimates, the timeline minimap, toasts, device frames, settings editors and pickers, diff and file-tree indentation)
pendingArea.next: scale each at its source by the root size, as atRootFontSize does for the composer
a size prop from the Contract; the composer follows the Prompt font size (px) and its chips scale with it
